## Core Fields

Every Identify call must have either a `userId` or `anonymousId` (at least one required).

| Field | Required? | Type | Notes |
|-------|-----------|------|-------|
| `type` | Yes | String | Always `"identify"` |
| `userId` | Required if no `anonymousId` | String | Unique identifier for the user in your database (e.g., database ID in UUIDv4 format). Preferred over email/username because it never changes. |
| `anonymousId` | Required if no `userId` | String | Pseudo-unique identifier when user identity is unknown (e.g., session ID, random UUIDv4). Segment's libraries auto-generate these. |
| `traits` | Optional | Object | Free-form user properties. Can include reserved trait names (see table below). |

## Additional Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `context` | Object | Request context (e.g., `ip`, `userAgent`) |
| `messageId` | String | Unique message identifier |
| `timestamp` | String | ISO-8601 datetime when the event occurred |
| `sentAt` | String | ISO-8601 datetime when the event was sent |
| `receivedAt` | String | ISO-8601 datetime when Segment received it |
| `channel` | String | Source channel (e.g., `"browser"`) |
| `integrations` | Object | Destination routing (e.g., `{"All": false, "Mixpanel": true}`) |
| `version` | String | Spec version (e.g., `"1.1"`) |

## Minimal Example

```json
{
  "type": "identify",
  "userId": "97980cfea0067",
  "traits": {
    "name": "Peter Gibbons",
    "email": "peter@example.com",
    "plan": "premium"
  }
}
```

## JavaScript API

```js
analytics.identify("97980cfea0067", {
  name: "Peter Gibbons",
  email: "peter@example.com",
  plan: "premium",
  logins: 5
});

// Anonymous user
analytics.identify({
  subscriptionStatus: 'inactive'
});
```

## Reserved Traits

Use these trait names for standardized semantics. Segment handles destination-specific conversions automatically. Accepts both camelCase and snake_case.

| Trait | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `address` | Object | Street address; optionally contains `city`, `country`, `postalCode`, `state`, `street` |
| `age` | Number | User's age |
| `avatar` | String | URL to avatar image |
| `birthday` | Date | User's birthday |
| `company` | Object | Company details; optionally contains `name` (String), `id` (String/Number), `industry` (String), `employee_count` (Number), `plan` (String) |
| `createdAt` | Date | Account creation date (use ISO-8601 format) |
| `description` | String | User description |
| `email` | String | Email address |
| `firstName` | String | First name |
| `gender` | String | Gender |
| `id` | String | Unique ID in your database |
| `lastName` | String | Last name |
| `name` | String | Full name (auto-filled if only first/last provided) |
| `phone` | String | Phone number |
| `title` | String | Job title (e.g., "VP of Engineering") |
| `username` | String | Username (must be unique per user) |
| `website` | String | User's website |

**Note:** Only use reserved traits for their intended meaning. Custom traits beyond this list are passed as-is.

## When to Call Identify

- After user first registers
- After user logs in
- When user updates their info
